# Module `ldp.input`

> Seats and input devices: pointer, keyboard (xkb keymaps), touch, stylus and tablets, and gesture recognition. Events use f32 surface coordinates (subpixel precision for touch and stylus).

Version range **1–1** · 6 interfaces · 5 requests · 45 events · 7 enums · 1 bitsets.

## Interfaces

### `ldp.input.seat`

One seat: a coherent set of input devices with its own focus, keyboard map, clipboard and data device. Seats never share focus or selections.

*global (registry-advertised)*

|---:|---|---:|---|---|
| 1 | `get_pointer` | 1 | — | `id: new_id<pointer>` |

| 3 | `get_touch` | 1 | — | `id: new_id<touch>` |
| 4 | `get_tablet` | 1 | — | `id: new_id<tablet>` |

### `ldp.input.pointer`

Pointer events of one seat. `motion` carries absolute surface coordinates; `relative_motion` carries raw and accelerated deltas for games and camera control. Scroll sequences group into atomic updates terminated by `frame`.

#### Events

|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `enter` | 1 | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `x: float32`, `y: float32` |

| 3 | `motion` | 1 | `x: float32`, `y: float32` |
| 4 | `relative_motion` | 1 | `dx_unaccel: float32`, `dy_unaccel: float32`, `dx_accel: float32`, `dy_accel: float32` |
| 5 | `button` | 1 | `button: uint32`, `state: enum<button_state>` |
| 6 | `axis` | 1 | `axis: enum<axis>`, `value: float32` |
| 7 | `axis_discrete` | 1 | `axis: enum<axis>`, `discrete: int32` |
| 8 | `axis_stop` | 1 | `axis: enum<axis>` |
| 9 | `axis_source` | 1 | `source: enum<axis_source>` |
| 10 | `frame` | 1 | — |

### `ldp.input.keyboard`

Keyboard events of one seat. The keymap is delivered once as a read-only FD; `modifiers` carries the xkb modifier group state; repeat is modeled server-side with the parameters from `repeat_info`.

#### Events

| Opcode | Name | Since | Arguments |
|---:|---|---:|---|
| 1 | `keymap` | 1 | `fd: fd`, `format: enum<keymap_format>` |
| 2 | `enter` | 1 | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>`, `keys: array<uint32>` |
| 3 | `leave` | 1 | `surface: object<ldp.core.surface>` |
| 4 | `key` | 1 | `keycode: uint32`, `state: enum<key_state>` |
| 5 | `modifiers` | 1 | `depressed: uint32`, `latched: uint32`, `locked: uint32`, `group: uint32` |
| 6 | `repeat_info` | 1 | `rate: int32`, `delay: int32` |

* `enter.keys` — Pressed evdev keycodes.

### `ldp.input.touch`

Multitouch events of one seat. Touch sequences group into frames terminated by `frame`. `cancel` invalidates the whole current sequence (device grab/dependency loss).

| 7 | `orientation` | 1 | `id: uint32`, `orientation: float32` |

### `ldp.input.tablet`

Stylus/tablet events of one seat. Tool changes are announced with `tool` / `tool_done` (proximity). Axis events group into frames like touch. Axes are normalized 0..1 (pressure, slider) or radians (tilt, rotation).

### `ldp.input.gestures`

Recognized touchpad gestures. `id` groups a gesture instance; deltas are in logical pixels. `cancelled` marks gestures interrupted by device state.

#### Events

| 1 | `swipe_begin` | 1 | `id: uint32`, `fingers: uint32` |
